plan.scene: A sunlit modernist courtyard with smooth curved stucco walls painted saturated Barragan pink, a still turquoise infinity pool and a pale warm concrete deck, under a clear deep blue sky in bright midday sun with crisp shadows.

shots.what: the lead woman seen from behind in a deep lunge on the deck at the pool edge, one arm raised high
a handheld selfie view inside a rectangular picture-in-picture frame on a plain pink backdrop: one woman's open hand reaches toward the lens while a second woman smiles behind her
the lead woman in a wide crescent lunge on the deck, back arched and arms reaching back, pool and curved pink wall behind
close-up from behind of the lead woman's hips and legs in the leggings as she steps forward, pool behind
close-up from behind of the lead woman whipping her head around so her ponytail swings, pool behind
the lead woman mid-leap in the air with her back arched against the curved pink wall and blue sky
a moving close-up along one woman's hip that travels into the group of women walking and laughing together along the pool edge

subjects.role: the lead woman, the only person in the single-person shots (10.9-12.1 s and 13.0-15.9 s)
subjects.traits: a woman in her twenties with deep brown skin and dark hair in a sleek high ponytail, wearing black high-waisted full-length leggings with one single wide bright tangerine-orange stripe down the outer side of each leg and a black scoop-neck sports bra with solid tangerine-orange shoulder straps

subjects.role: the two women in the framed selfie shot and every woman in the walking group of the last shot
subjects.traits: athletic women of different ethnicities and hairstyles, all wearing the same black high-waisted leggings with one single wide tangerine-orange stripe down the outer side of each leg and black sports bras with tangerine-orange shoulder straps

constraints: No text, captions, watermarks or logos anywhere in the frame; the only branding is the single tangerine-orange stripe and the orange straps on the clothing.
Every woman wears only the black set with the orange stripe from Image 2, exactly one orange stripe per leg.
The walls are saturated pink in every shot, as in Image 3.
